description: This Java class defines LogWrapper, a helper class that implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, enabling log messages to be passed through a chain of log nodes. It facilitates organized logging with optional chaining for multiple targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface for chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional throwable, and passes it to the next node in the chain if present.
